notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for callback enable and disable around standard timeAdvanceRequestAvailable and nextMessageRequestAvailable delivery. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, logical-time implementation, and callback configuration. It verifies suppression and release of timestamped interaction and timeAdvanceGrant callbacks, interaction-before-grant ordering, exact payload/tag/producer/time/order/retraction metadata, and time/federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador callback enable/disable and callback-servicing controls with timeAdvanceRequestAvailable/nextMessageRequestAvailable services and FederateAmbassador receiveInteraction/timeAdvanceGrant delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador callback-control and available time-advance declarations
